title: Empowering Youth in AI Governance
query: How does AI4IA discuss youth empowerment and AI governance?
summary: The AI4IA conference emphasizes the importance of empowering youth to shape the future of AI and ensuring inclusive governance. Speakers highlight the need for education, policy, and innovation to mitigate risks and maximize opportunities. Youth participation in policy development is crucial to remove bias and create a just and uniting African future.
